title: Company extraction trap mentioning Google Meet or another platform
description: Recruiter message mentions third-party software platforms (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) for technical interviews, which can trick extractors into investigating Google instead of actual employer V-Guard Industries.
raw_text:
V-Guard Industries Ltd.
Recruitment Notice for Quality Assurance Engineer.
Dear Candidate, your final interview will be conducted online via Google Meet.
Please join the Google Meet link 5 minutes prior to the scheduled slot: https://meet.google.example/abc-defg-hij.
Official HR communication: careers@vguard.example.

organic_results.title: V-Guard Careers: Opportunities
organic_results.snippet: Official careers portal for V-Guard Industries.

rationale: Tooling and meeting platform names ('Google Meet', 'Microsoft Teams', 'Zoom') often lead extractors to investigate Google or Microsoft, creating false company verification for unrelated scam offers.
